qa.name: minor-label-consumer-break
qa.sentence: A severity label, the lens, the wording or any other predicate never makes a blocker eligible, and an exclusion always makes it ineligible.
qa.action: Apply eligibility: the stated consequence breaks an existing consumer; the label does not make it eligible.

qa.name: item4-bookkeeping
qa.sentence: its area names review_scope item 4 or CHECK 1;
qa.action: Apply exclusions: the area names review_scope item 4.

qa.name: security-weaker-proof
qa.sentence: it names a security or privacy path, a protected asset, a merge-gate criterion or an existing consumer;
qa.action: Apply exclusions: it names a security path (credential), so the weaker-proof reading never applies.

qa.name: classification-dispute
qa.sentence: it disputes the plan's Mandatory class, Risk tier, reviewer set or whole-diff-review decision;
qa.action: Apply exclusions: the blocker disputes the plan's Mandatory class.

qa.name: gate-record-evidence
qa.sentence: it concerns the audit trail: the gate record, its trailers, or a QA artifact the validator binds;
qa.action: Apply exclusions: the audit trail (QA artifact the validator binds).

qa.name: check5-evidence-binding
qa.sentence: A blocker is Accept-eligible only when it misses both limbs of the blocking threshold in the Phase 2 briefs
qa.action: Apply eligibility: misses both limbs, no exclusion; recommend Accept.

qa.name: verify-gap-material-behaviour
qa.sentence: A missing proof of any material behaviour or failure mode breaks the value proof, even when the criterion is partly proven;
qa.action: Apply the value-proof reading: the Verify command cannot fail when the German translations break, a material behaviour stays unproven.

qa.name: evidence-form-gap
qa.sentence: only a gap in the form of evidence (binding, wording, bookkeeping outside the audit trail) for a behaviour that stays proven by a check that can fail is weaker proof.
qa.action: Apply the value-proof reading: the test itself still runs and can fail; only the RED/GREEN evidence record for task 6.1 is missing, a gap in the form of evidence. Assumes no criterion names the RED evidence.

qa.name: mandatory-class-bookkeeping
qa.sentence: the change's mandatory class is not `none`;
qa.action: Apply exclusions: mandatory class is not none.

qa.name: unstated-consequence
qa.sentence: A blocker with no stated consequence, an ambiguous one, or one that mixes a process gap with a code or design path is not eligible.
qa.action: Apply the ambiguity default.

qa.name: mixed-consequence
qa.sentence: A blocker with no stated consequence, an ambiguous one, or one that mixes a process gap with a code or design path is not eligible.
qa.action: Apply the ambiguity default: mixes an evidence gap with a code path.

qa.name: unrequested-checker
qa.sentence: Never answer an eligible blocker by adding a mechanism, script, procedure or check the proposal did not ask for: it goes to the user as Accept, or becomes its own plan,
qa.action: Apply the no-unrequested-mechanism rule: present Accept or a separate plan.

qa.name: authorization-fix
qa.sentence: A non-eligible blocker is fixed with whatever the correct fix needs, including a new check;
qa.action: Not eligible (consumer/security path); fix includes the authorization recheck the proposal did not name.

qa.name: f2-eligible-blocker
qa.sentence: `below-threshold` only for an eligible blocker, `accepted-residual` and `out-of-scope` only for a covered one.
qa.action: Phase 4 override with `below-threshold` for an eligible blocker, user agreed.

qa.name: f2-override-uncovered
qa.sentence: The ordinary override, outside a convergence STOP, never accepts a non-eligible, uncovered blocker, even on the user's request,
qa.action: Offer no override; offer fix, another wave or re-plan.

qa.name: coverage-exact-match
qa.sentence: Coverage is the existing `accepted-residual`/`out-of-scope` path: the entry was reviewed with the plan, so a covered blocker may stay unfixed even when it breaks the threshold.
qa.action: Covered: record `accepted-residual`.

qa.name: coverage-other-consequence
qa.sentence: A blocker is covered only when an `Accepted residual risks` or `Out of scope for blocking` entry of the plan's reviewed merge-gate section (`gate.md` for an OpenSpec folder) names the same defect class and consequence; a broad area list covers no specific blocker.
qa.action: Same class, other consequence: not covered, no override.

qa.name: coverage-broad-entry
qa.sentence: A blocker is covered only when an `Accepted residual risks` or `Out of scope for blocking` entry of the plan's reviewed merge-gate section (`gate.md` for an OpenSpec folder) names the same defect class and consequence; a broad area list covers no specific blocker.
qa.action: Broad area list: not covered.

qa.name: covered-security-broad-entry
qa.sentence: Coverage never applies to an excluded blocker.
qa.action: Excluded blocker: coverage never applies.

qa.name: f2-freeze-security-delta
qa.sentence: it comes from a `security_delta: yes` trailer;
qa.action: Exclusion: freeze not offered.

qa.name: delta-accept-noneligible
qa.sentence: Recommend and offer accept only when every open blocker of the delta is eligible or covered under [Blocker disposition](#blocker-disposition);
qa.action: Accept not recommended or offered; amend or re-plan, naming the consequence.

qa.name: delta-accept-insisted
qa.sentence: An accept the user asks for anyway, for blockers no exclusion names, puts the user's reason and each blocker's stated consequence in `--reason`.
qa.action: Record `GC accept --reason` with the user's reason and the stated consequence.

qa.name: f2-override-insisted
qa.sentence: The ordinary override, outside a convergence STOP, never accepts a non-eligible, uncovered blocker, even on the user's request,
qa.action: No override; offer fix, another wave or re-plan.

qa.name: f2-freeze-insisted
qa.sentence: A freeze the user asks for anyway, for blockers no exclusion names, carries the user's reason and each blocker's stated consequence in the `frozen` entries;
qa.action: Freeze with `frozen` entries carrying the user's reason and stated consequence.

qa.name: f2-freeze-excluded-insisted
qa.sentence: An excluded blocker is never accepted, frozen or overridden at any path, even on the user's request:
qa.action: Excluded: never frozen; offer fix, re-plan or stop.

qa.name: all-eligible-round
qa.sentence: At least one eligible blocker: ask in this round, before any fix.
qa.action: Write review.md, ask now with Accept recommended.

qa.name: blocking-defect-round
qa.sentence: No eligible blocker: fix each blocker of every rejecting lens in the artifacts (never in source code), then repeat from step 1 as a new round with three fresh lenses.
qa.action: Fix and new round without an ask.

qa.name: incomplete-round
qa.sentence: If the retry also has no structured verdict, the round is incomplete: write no review.md and edit no existing one, tell the user which lens failed, and stop.
qa.action: Incomplete: existing stop.

qa.name: mixed-round-ask
qa.sentence: Then ask as in step 6, one question per open blocker. Next fix the non-eligible blockers and those the user chose to fix, write each Accept into gate.md, and repeat from step 1.
qa.action: Ask per blocker in this round, fix non-eligible, new round.

qa.name: third-reject-mixed
qa.sentence: For a non-eligible blocker offer only Fix and Stop.
qa.action: Ask per blocker; non-eligible gets only Fix and Stop.

qa.name: plan-accept-effect
qa.sentence: the user's reason, in their words, goes into gate.md as an Accepted residual risk or an Out of scope area
qa.action: Reason enters gate.md as Accepted residual risk; new round.

qa.name: plan-override-insisted
qa.sentence: If the user asks to accept one anyway and no exclusion names it, record their reason and the blocker's stated consequence in gate.md;
qa.action: Record the user's reason and the stated consequence in gate.md.

qa.name: section-unreadable-plan
qa.sentence: If that section cannot be read, every blocker is not eligible: tell the user once in this review that Accept is off.
qa.action: No eligible blocker; tell the user once that Accept is off; fix.

qa.name: ask-quotes-verbatim
qa.sentence: Each question quotes the blocker's area, defect and stated consequence verbatim from the lens output and names the exclusions you checked for it.
qa.action: Ask quotes area, defect and consequence verbatim and names the exclusions checked.

qa.name: stale-okay-superseded
qa.sentence: First write review.md for this round (step 5), so a Stop or an interrupted session leaves no earlier OKAY current.
qa.action: review.md records the REJECT before the ask; --reviewed fails.

qa.name: plan-excluded-insisted
qa.sentence: an excluded blocker gets no gate.md entry, only Fix, re-plan or Stop.
qa.action: No gate.md entry; Fix, re-plan or Stop.

qa.name: f3-freeze-eligible
qa.sentence: Recommend and offer freeze only when every remaining Must-fix class is eligible or covered;
qa.action: Recommend freeze.

qa.name: f3-freeze-noneligible
qa.sentence: otherwise offer re-plan or continue (re-plan only under Risk tier `internal-tooling` at wave 3 or later, where `GC decide` refuses continue) and name each such class with its stated consequence.
qa.action: Offer re-plan or continue, not freeze, naming the class and consequence.

qa.name: f3-freeze-insisted
qa.sentence: the class goes to the report's follow-up list as today, and `GC decide --lane F3 --reason` carries the user's reason and the class's stated consequence;
qa.action: Follow-up list as today; GC decide --reason carries reason and consequence.

qa.name: section-unreadable-f3
qa.sentence: If that section cannot be read, no class is eligible and no freeze is offered: tell the user so once.
qa.action: No freeze offered; tell the user once.

qa.action: bun probe: installTeamConfig into a disposable agentDir, hash the three edited files
